Filter Several Score-Driven Terms Backwards

Source: R/gas_joint.R
term_adjoint.GasJoint.Rd

Runs the joint recursion of term_filter() in reverse and returns the derivative of a caller's objective with respect to the static predictors of the filtered parameters and with respect to the driving scores.

Arguments

term

A GasJoint().

eta, y, score, curvature, psi

As for term_filter().

g

The direct derivative of the objective in the filtered predictors, a matrix like eta.

...

Unused.

stored_curv

NULL, or the curv that term_filter() returned at the same parameters and static predictors; where it is NULL, the forward pass is run to obtain it. The name is not a prefix of curvature, so that it cannot be matched partially to that argument.

fast, threads

Passed to that forward pass.

Value

A list with deta and dscore, matrices like eta.

Details

With \(\bar f_{k,t}\) the derivative of the objective in the level and \(\bar u_{l,t}\) in the driving score, the objective reaches the filtered predictor \(e_{k,t}\) directly through g and through every driving score read there, \(\bar e_{k,t} = g_{k,t} + \sum_l \bar u_{l,t} C_{t,lk}\); the level passes this on to its own earlier values through the persistence and to the earlier driving scores through the loadings. The pass reads the curvature \(C_t\) that the forward pass stored and runs compiled.
